extractions.value: Patient developed SPS after autologous bone marrow transplantation and interferon treatment for multiple myeloma. SPS symptoms began during first 2 years posttransplant. This is the second report of SPS in a patient with myeloma and the first description of SPS following autologous transplantation. Authors speculate aberrant posttransplant immune response may have caused both SPS and autologous graft-versus-myeloma effect. Serum CK minimally elevated at 132 U/L (normal 15-120 U/L). HLA typing: DRB1 03, 07, DQB1 02 (homozygous).
